paragraphs.text: The Kukemssa (koo-khems-sah ) is the vast ocean that lies to the west of Jamuraa on Dominaria .

A deep ocean populated by serpents and fearsome sea creatures, the bane of Kukemssa are the pirates whose blood-colored sails inspire fear in any sailor. Far across the Kukemssa's depths lie the Burning Isles . The sea is heated by the nearby volcanoes.
In the west, the Kukemssa Sea is bordered by the Voda Sea . In the north, it reaches to Corondor and the Golthonor Sea , and in the south to Madara and the Edemi Islands .
Kukemssa's name is derived from Swahili kuchemsha , meaning "to boil".
